# qual-09 expected outcome (written before any run)

**Turn 1** (message-1, two vague goals and a hedged method).

- Quote: message-1, whole, byte for byte.
- Faithful objectives: sign-up is more secure (against a threat still to be named),
  and the sign-up form is faster on mobile. One objective item with both, or two
  items; neither names 2FA.
- Methods: M1 "add 2FA", attributed to `owner`, `claim_type: hypothesis` (it is
  hedged: "Maybe ... Not sure"), with a hypothesis item.
- Clarifications that must be raised (open): what "more secure" protects against
  (account takeover, fake or bot sign-ups, ...), which decides whether 2FA fits; what
  "faster" and "takes forever" mean (form load or completion time, on which devices
  and networks, with which target). Noting the tension between an added 2FA step and
  a faster sign-up is a plus.
- Must not: criteria with invented targets presented as the Owner's; 2FA in an
  objective or criterion; any accepted item.
